collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-39  -  THE PROMISE TO THE SHORE SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: Several friends once agreed to keep a favorite stretch of beach clean, but their visits have become less frequent.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Several friends once agreed to keep a favorite stretch of beach free of discarded materials, but their visits have become less frequent.

choices.label: Gather the Friends and Renew the Agreement.
Begin Caring for the Beach Independently.
Discuss Why the Original Promise Became Difficult to Keep.
Invite Other Villagers to Share Responsibility.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They organize a modest cleanup and enjoy spending time together again.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Some cannot participate regularly, so the group adopts a more realistic arrangement.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The villager removes several scraps and leaves the shore cleaner.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The work proves larger than expected, and the villager asks others for help.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The friends admit that changing responsibilities made their earlier plan impractical.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: One friend feels guilty, but the others focus on what they can reasonably do now.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: More households contribute small amounts of time without depending on a single group.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Few volunteers are available, so the friends concentrate on the most affected area.
